memory_update.text: HSTM should be tracked as a low-attention healthcare education infrastructure candidate: healthcare learning, credentialing, clinical development, scheduling, and simulation-based education management are closer to the node than generic online-learning platforms.

UTI's Concorde division creates a hidden healthcare-capacity angle inside a company often labeled as automotive/skilled-trades education; verify Concorde segment growth and clinical-placement/lab constraints.

summary: Layer 1B expansion for the healthcare-education capacity node found one context anchor and three underfollowed/smaller-cap public exposures. Grand Canyon Education is the clearest reference asset because provided evidence says it supports university-partner ABSN and OTA programs and invests in simulation technology, virtual reality, and prerequisite strategies. The underfollowed discovery lane points to HealthStream as a niche healthcare workforce/training/credentialing and simulation-management software vendor; Universal Technical Institute as an allied-health and nursing capacity operator through Concorde Career Colleges; and CAE as a US-listed simulation-equipment and healthcare-training supplier whose healthcare exposure is relevant but diluted by aviation and defense.
